# Multiple repositories in one database remain isolated

Creates two separate repositories, initializes both in the same Postgres instance, compiles each, and asserts that their stored entity slugs differ and that repo-scoped entities (like component/billing vs component/net-client) are present only in their respective repo. This enforces the multi-repo isolation invariant in the storage layer.
